description.p: Start a room, send the link, and everyone in it can go live at the same time. There are no accounts and no media server: peers connect directly, end-to-end encrypted, with relay fallback.

ul.li: Screen sharing for everyone at once, up to 4K60 with a hardware encoder, with optional app or system audio
Voice with echo cancellation and noise suppression, and webcams
Room chat and peer-to-peer file transfers
Contacts: see who is online, ring them, send files outside calls
Light on resources: nothing is encoded while nobody watches

screenshot.caption: A room with two people live, participant tiles and chat

description.p: Discord-style formatting in room chat and direct messages, with spoilers, highlighted code blocks, quotes, headings and lists; a message box that formats as you type; a check before web links open; multi-line room messages; and a bundled font so bold text looks right everywhere.

Direct messages, recent rooms with saved chat, mute people for yourself, change a live stream's quality without stopping, better pop-out windows, new call sounds, installers and signed automatic updates.
